Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment described in the 'Sample preparation and Liquid chromatography–mass spectrometry (LC–MS/MS) analysis' section and PRIDE metadata is a baseline characterization of ten different liver cancer cell lines. While the broader study performs numerous perturbations (CRISPR KO, siRNA, drug treatments) and viral infections, these are analyzed via RNA-FISH, Western Blot, and qPCR, not via the MS proteomics pipeline. The MS data is used for 'full proteome characterisation' of the cell lines themselves, which is a descriptive/profiling study rather than a differential perturbation study.
